GuideCommand.description: Writes use optimistic concurrency on the whole logical guide/revision, including both platforms. checkpoint requires in_progress; complete requires in_progress at the last platform step. Terminal guides must be restored before resuming. skip applies to both; restore clears only the requesting platform checkpoint/home/deferral. New explicit complete/skip after restoration applies to both again. A successful identical request retry returns current state without replaying the action. After 409 reload, reconcile and use a new request ID for a changed command. Actions never create stock or homes. Renderer v2 introduction completion for writers also requires a saved, same-home inventory reference from /guides/{id}/setup; viewers may finish the explanation-only path. This does not change renderer-v1 completion semantics. For demo_house, an omitted home_id resolves to the authenticated user's private demo; an explicitly different home is rejected. Personal introduction progress cannot advance in demo homes.

GuideSetupCommand.description: Renderer-v2 introduction only. Send exactly the resource input corresponding to action. X-Home-Id is required; home_id/step_id/defer_until are not accepted. Uses the same user/guide/revision aggregate and per-user request receipts as lifecycle actions. Choose/create a definition from the definition step; save stock from stock (web) or inventory (mobile); reuse stock from either definition or stock/inventory. Each save and checkpoint commit atomically. Identical retries return current state without creating duplicates.

get.summary: List the current platform guide catalog and effective user progress
get.description: Returns active/published variants supported by client_version, including completed/skipped guides for Settings. Accounts predating publication are eligible. Unavailable home/role/prerequisite states are retained with reasons; unsupported/inactive/unpublished variants are omitted. No progress is created by this read. client_version is an integer guide-renderer capability version, not an application semantic version. All responses are private and must not be cached. Renderer client_version >= 3 additionally discovers demo_house, eligible after introduction is completed or skipped and a private demo is available. Its context is demo_home_id, independent of the selected real home. Demo houses cannot satisfy personal introduction progress.

parameters.name: X-Home-Id
parameters.description: Optional selected home for eligibility. Otherwise authorized retained platform context is used.

200.description: Platform guide metadata and current state.

400.description: Invalid or oversized request, malformed platform/client context or unexpected fields.

500.description: Storage operation failed; no partial action is committed.

post.summary: Apply a guide lifecycle action for the authenticated user
post.description: Completion/skip propagates atomically to both web/mobile variants of this logical guide, even before first use of the other app. Checkpoint, deferral and restore are platform-specific. The saved platform-only restore survives normal reads/login until a later explicit action supersedes it. No user_id is accepted. Guide status is tutorial bookkeeping, not authorization to business APIs.

200.description: Current state of the requesting platform after a successful action or identical retry.

400.description: Invalid or oversized request, malformed platform/client context or unexpected fields.

403.description: Required home access, role or prerequisite is missing.

404.description: Guide has no active, published, supported variant for this client.

409.description: Stale aggregate/catalog revision, reused request ID, or invalid transition. Reload before reconciling.

500.description: Storage operation failed; no partial action is committed.

post.summary: Atomically save or select introduction resources and their checkpoint
post.description: Renderer-v2 introduction only. Send exactly the resource input corresponding to action. X-Home-Id is required; home_id/step_id/defer_until are not accepted. Uses the same user/guide/revision aggregate and per-user request receipts as lifecycle actions. Choose/create a definition from the definition step; save stock from stock (web) or inventory (mobile); reuse stock from either definition or stock/inventory. Each save and checkpoint commit atomically. Identical retries return current state without creating duplicates.

200.description: Current state of the requesting platform after a successful action or identical retry.

400.description: Invalid or oversized request, malformed platform/client context or unexpected fields.

403.description: Required home access, role or prerequisite is missing.

404.description: Guide is not supported, or selected definition/category/inventory does not exist in the selected home.

409.description: Stale aggregate/catalog revision, reused request ID, or invalid transition. Reload before reconciling.

500.description: Resource creation, transaction log, shopping updates, checkpoint and receipt roll back together.

get.summary: Read the authenticated user's private demo availability
get.description: No provisioning occurs on this read. Missing history is not_created at version 0; deliberate removal is removed with its retained version. Only an available private home is returned. Responses are private/no-store.

403.description: Private demo ownership or membership is invalid.

500.description: Storage failed; retry an uncertain command with its exact original ID/payload.

post.summary: Explicitly create, reset or remove the user's private demo
post.description: Profile sync automatically creates a separate real/default and demo/non-default home together when no real membership exists and no demo registry decision exists. Existing users may explicitly opt in here. All operations serialize per user; reset/remove affect only owned demo content. Receipts commit atomically with mutations and share the guide request-ID namespace. A stale command gets 409; reload/reconcile before changing its payload or ID. Guide Restore is a separate operation and never invokes provisioning.

200.description: Current demo state after successful command or identical retry.

400.description: Malformed, oversized or invalid command.

403.description: Private demo ownership or membership is invalid.

404.description: Reset/remove requested without an available demo.

409.description: Version conflict, reused request ID, or create requested while a demo already exists.

500.description: Storage failed; retry an uncertain command with its exact original ID/payload.
